sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You are likely to be in a mood to get away from the daily grind and take a much need break. You would naturally try to stay free from future concerns and commitments and keep all your woes and worries aside for the day. An adventurous and fun filled outing or a trip to some happening resort, along with your friends and family members is a near certainty, assures Ganesha. Don’t miss out on this opportunity.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: It's important that you abandon the myth that you don't have any gifts or talents, Taurus. Consider thinking about your talents in the same way you think about your body. When you exercise, eat right, and get plenty of rest, your body responds. Your talents are no different. They need care and nurturing, too.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Smile as it is best antidote for all your problems. If you had borrowed some money from a member of your family, then it is best to return it today, or else that member can take legal action against you. There will be an important development on your personal front which will bring jubilation for you and your entire family. It is good to spend time alone, but you can grow anxious over something going on in your mind. Therefore, we advise you to contact an experienced person and share your troubles with them. Your spouse might deny to satisfy your needs today, which will eventually make you feel frustrated.

readings.text: The day is going to be good from work point of view. Today you will be able to judge things in advance which will help you quicken routine work. Overall, you will be very decisive and confident today, feels Ganesha.

Today marks the start of a four-week period that asks you to put more fun and creativity into your career. Let your work be an extension of your creative self-expression. Use this time to let your artistic spirit shine. Put yourself out in the world.
You may think of buying a shop and give it on rent. At the same time, it is not advisable to start your own business today. It’s time to earn some easy money, says Ganesha.

This week, you have positive and negative news about your financial life. If you've been true to your goals and kept within budget, this planet provides new opportunities to make more money. If you've overspent, sudden and perhaps unexpected changes in your career sector could mean that what you counted on to cover bills may not be there. Saving for the future can get you through this time.

readings.text: Your health will be good today still you will be concerned about it, says Ganesha. There will be strong desire to maintain health thus you might be inclined to do Yoga or any other exercise. Your high creative energy will keep you happy.

With today's planetary alignment, you will be especially sensitive to the needs of others - with a special emphasis on family and children. You may want to consider enhancing your home environment in some nurturing way. Is it time to upgrade your kitchen? A simple planter box by your kitchen window is attractive and practical. Rosemary, parsley, and basil are some suggestions.
